title: Yummy Italian Ham Panettone
description: A savory Italian panettone filled with ham and topped with sugar-free raspberry jam, perfect for a quick energizing breakfast.
instructions: Preheat oven to 180C and grease a panettone mold or a loaf pan.
In a bowl, combine flour, yeast, salt and stevia, mixing well.
Warm milk to 38C, add softened butter and stir until melted.
Beat eggs in a separate bowl and add the milk mixture to the dry ingredients, stirring until a soft dough forms.
Knead the dough on a floured surface for 8 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in the prepared pan, cover, and let rise for 60 minutes until doubled in size.
Bake the panettone for 35 minutes, then remove and allow to cool for 10 minutes before slicing.
Slice the cooled panettone, spread a thin layer of raspberry jam, layer ham slices inside, reassemble the loaf and pack into a bento box.
